businesses.business: Radiation therapy equipment leasing and treatment centers

offering_description.value: The company provides stereotactic radiosurgery and radiation therapy equipment to hospitals and medical centers through long-term leasing arrangements. It also operates treatment centers that provide radiation therapy and radiosurgery directly to patients.

primary_services.value: Radiosurgery and radiation therapy equipment leasing; outpatient radiation therapy; stereotactic radiosurgery

customer_segment.value: B2B: Hospitals and medical centers offering radiation oncology or neurosurgery; B2C: Patients receiving radiation therapy or stereotactic radiosurgery

end_markets.value: Hospital radiation oncology; neurosurgery; outpatient cancer care

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: Long-term access to radiosurgery and radiation therapy systems, with some agreements priced per procedure; healthcare reimbursement: Insurer and public payer reimbursement for patient treatments at company-operated centers

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: Acquires treatment systems from manufacturers and leases them to hospitals and medical centers; service provider: Uses radiation therapy systems and clinical staff to treat referred patients at its centers

geography_served.value: global: United States and Latin America, including Peru

specialization.value: related lines: Leasing of stereotactic radiosurgery, proton therapy and linear accelerator systems, plus direct patient treatment

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Equipment leasing agreements negotiated directly with hospitals and medical centers; own locations: Company-operated treatment centers that receive physician referrals

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Treatment center licensing, radiation safety oversight and Medicare reimbursement rules for U.S. patient care

notes: The current treatment center roster and full list of countries served are uncertain.
